MID-CYCLE MANUAL RUN: judgment written 2026-08-26, five calendar days after the 2026-08-21 close this file reads. Two of the five sessions in the week window (Mon 08-24, Tue 08-25) had already traded. The three catalysts that dominate the window -- July core PCE and NVDA earnings (both 08-26), and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote (08-28) -- were all still ahead, and the pinned research snapshot (2026-08-24) carries no post-08-21 outcomes. The week horizon is still not a clean ex-ante forecast and must not be graded as one.

why: Archetype 1 is one of Health Care's weakest regimes: +17.4 pct absolute against SPY's +31.3 pct, -13.9 pts excess. Defensives get left behind in a steady mid-cycle expansion, and their documented edge is in exogenous shocks and transitions, not expansions (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

THIS IS THE RUN'S SHARPEST CONTRADICTION AND IT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT STANDING. The arithmetic says leadership: rank 1 of 11 on the week at +7.30 pts vs SPY, 80.0 breadth, XLV +4.33 pct closing above both its 50D and 200D on strong volume, forward P/E ~18.5x against a five-year ~21x. The regime research says lag. Both are reading the same week (panel metrics, this file; wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433; The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).
risks: If the rotation into Health Care is late-cycle defensive positioning rather than a value re-rate, it is evidence the regime is turning -- the technician read this week was explicitly 'distribution', with breadth collapsing in tech and industrials and concentrating in healthcare and energy (wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433).

why: The month panel is +10.08 pts vs SPY with 90.0 breadth, the strongest in the run, which widens rather than resolves the disagreement with the archetype-1 prior (panel metrics, this file).

The valuation case has a fundamental anchor: XLV's yield widened to ~1.65 pct against a 10Y at 4.738 pct, and the sector was marked 'value with a catalyst' rather than a value trap on the back of Mounjaro data and stable JNJ guidance (wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433).
risks: A resolution of this contradiction in the archetype's favour would show up as the rotation reversing once the rate scare passes; grade this sector first at close, because it is the run's cleanest test of whether the regime label or the tape is doing the work.

extracts.lead_summary: Healthcare is the fortress in the storm. Expensive, yes. But when the market panics, the sick still get treated.
